🌐 [Tiếng Việt](../vi/glossary.md) · **English** · [日本語](../ja/glossary.md)

# Glossary in Three Languages

Each term is explained in English, with what it is called in Vietnamese and in Japanese.

| Term | Meaning | Tiếng Việt | 日本語 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Chatbot** | A program you talk to in text or voice; it replies with answers but does not act on your computer or other systems by itself. | Chatbot | チャットボット |
| **Large language model (LLM)** | An AI model trained on huge amounts of text to predict the next piece of text; it is the "brain" of chatbots and agents. | Mô hình ngôn ngữ lớn (LLM) | 大規模言語モデル（LLM）［だいきぼげんごモデル］ |
| **AI agent** | An AI system that takes a goal, plans the steps, uses tools to act, checks the results and repeats until the goal is done. | AI agent (tác tử AI) | AIエージェント |
| **Tool (for an AI)** | A capability the AI can call to act in the world, such as reading a file, running a command or searching the web. | Công cụ (tool) | ツール（AIの道具）［エーアイのどうぐ］ |
| **Agent loop** | The repeating cycle an agent runs — think about the next step, act with a tool, observe the result, then decide again. | Vòng lặp agent (agent loop) | エージェントループ |
| **Software** | The programs and data that tell a computer what to do, as opposed to the physical machine (hardware). | Phần mềm (software) | ソフトウェア |
| **Program** | A set of step-by-step instructions written in code that a computer can run. | Chương trình (program) | プログラム |
| **Code (source code)** | Text written in a programming language that people can read and computers can run. | Code (mã nguồn) | コード（ソースコード） |
| **File path** | The address of a file or folder on a computer, such as C:\Users\an\report.xlsx or /home/an/report.xlsx. | Đường dẫn (file path) | ファイルパス |
| **Terminal (command line)** | A text window where you type commands for the computer instead of clicking with the mouse. | Terminal (dòng lệnh) | ターミナル（コマンドライン） |
| **JSON** | A simple text format for structured data, made of names and values inside curly braces; widely used between programs. | JSON | JSON |
| **Bug** | A mistake in a program that makes it behave differently from what was intended. | Bug (lỗi phần mềm) | バグ |
| **Debugging** | Finding the cause of a bug and fixing it, usually by reading error messages and testing ideas one at a time. | Gỡ lỗi (debugging) | デバッグ |
| **API** | A defined way for one program to ask another for data or actions — like the menu a restaurant hands to its customers. | API | API |
| **Git** | A version control tool that records snapshots of a project so you can see every change and go back to an earlier state. | Git | Git（ギット） |
| **Commit** | One saved snapshot in Git, with a message describing what changed and why. | Commit | コミット |
| **Diff** | A view showing exactly which lines were added, removed or changed between two versions of a file. | Diff (so sánh thay đổi) | 差分（diff）［さぶん］ |
| **Test (automated test)** | A small program that checks whether other code behaves as expected, so mistakes are caught automatically. | Kiểm thử tự động (test) | テスト（自動テスト）［じどうテスト］ |
| **API key** | A secret string that identifies you to a service and can be billed for usage; never share it or put it in a public file. | API key | APIキー |
| **Machine learning (ML)** | A way to build AI in which a computer learns patterns from examples (data) instead of following hand-written rules. | Học máy (machine learning) | 機械学習［きかいがくしゅう］ |
| **Deep learning** | A kind of machine learning that uses neural networks with many layers; it powers modern image, speech and language AI. | Học sâu (deep learning) | 深層学習（ディープラーニング）［しんそうがくしゅう］ |
| **Model (AI model)** | The result of training — a huge set of learned numbers that turns an input into an output, such as a question into a reply. | Mô hình (model) | モデル（AIモデル） |
| **Training** | The process of adjusting a model's numbers using many examples until its outputs become good. | Huấn luyện (training) | 学習（トレーニング）［がくしゅう］ |
| **Generative AI** | AI that creates new content — text, images, audio, code — instead of only classifying things or predicting a label. | AI tạo sinh (generative AI) | 生成AI［せいせいエーアイ］ |
| **Foundation model** | A very large model trained on broad data that can be adapted to many different tasks. | Mô hình nền tảng (foundation model) | 基盤モデル［きばんモデル］ |
| **Prompt** | The instructions and information you give an AI model to get the output you want. | Prompt (câu lệnh cho AI) | プロンプト |
| **RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)** | A technique that first searches your documents for relevant passages, then gives them to the model so its answer is grounded in them. | RAG (tạo sinh có tăng cường truy xuất) | RAG（検索拡張生成）［けんさくかくちょうせいせい］ |
| **Fine-tuning** | Training an existing model a little more on your own examples so it picks up a specific style or skill. | Tinh chỉnh (fine-tuning) | ファインチューニング |
| **Agentic coding** | Building software by giving goals to AI agents that write, run and check code themselves, while you direct and review. | Agentic coding (lập trình cùng AI agent) | エージェント型コーディング［エージェントがたコーディング］ |
| **Vibe coding** | Casually prompting AI to generate code and accepting it without really reading it; fast for experiments, risky for real products. | Vibe coding | バイブコーディング |
| **Spec (specification)** | A written description of what to build — the goal, the constraints and how you will know it is done. | Đặc tả (spec) | 仕様（スペック）［しよう］ |
| **Acceptance criteria** | Specific, checkable conditions that must be true for a task to count as finished. | Tiêu chí nghiệm thu (acceptance criteria) | 受け入れ基準［うけいれきじゅん］ |
| **Token** | A small piece of text — a word, part of a word or a symbol — that an LLM reads and writes; usage and limits are counted in tokens. | Token | トークン |
| **Context window** | The maximum amount of text (counted in tokens) a model can consider at once — its short-term working memory. | Cửa sổ ngữ cảnh (context window) | コンテキストウィンドウ |
| **Hallucination** | When an AI states something false or made up as if it were true. | Ảo giác AI (hallucination) | ハルシネーション |
| **Function calling (tool calling)** | A model's ability to reply with a structured request to run a specific tool, which the surrounding program then executes. | Gọi công cụ (function calling / tool calling) | 関数呼び出し（ツール呼び出し）［かんすうよびだし・ツールよびだし］ |
| **Harness (agent harness)** | Everything around the model that turns it into a working agent — instructions, context, tools, permissions, memory and checks. | Harness (bộ khung điều khiển agent) | ハーネス（エージェントハーネス） |
| **Context engineering** | Deciding what information goes into a model's context window, and when, so it has exactly what the task needs. | Context engineering | コンテキストエンジニアリング |
| **Subagent** | A helper agent started by a main agent to handle one focused part of a task in its own separate context. | Subagent (agent phụ) | サブエージェント |
| **Hook** | A script that runs automatically at a set moment in an agent's work — for example before a command runs — to check or block it. | Hook | フック |
| **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** | An open standard for connecting AI applications to external tools and data sources through a common interface. | MCP (Model Context Protocol) | MCP（モデル・コンテキスト・プロトコル） |
| **CI (continuous integration)** | A service that automatically builds and tests a project every time someone pushes a change. | CI (tích hợp liên tục) | CI（継続的インテグレーション）［けいぞくてきインテグレーション］ |
| **Eval (evaluation)** | A repeatable set of test cases and scoring rules used to measure how well an AI system performs. | Eval (bài đánh giá) | 評価（Eval）［ひょうか］ |
